content:
I claimed this issue but realised that there is already a PR which addresses this (as another user has pointed out):
https://github.com/AlexKontorovich/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/issues/1291
Unclear what the protocol is around this situation.
I've left a comment at PNT#1533 (that has been inactive for a month) to see if the author is still interested in finalizing it (currently there are merge conflicts).

Oops, I confused two issues with similar names. The PR on this is PNT#1437, not PNT#1533. It actually looks good to me, but I defer to @Alex Kontorovich who is managing the IK subproject to have the final word.

I have now proposed PR #1437 in issue #1291 and marked the PR as awaiting review. I was attempting to stack another PR on top of it: https://github.com/AlexKontorovich/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/pull/1728
that takes care of the optional golfing issues but decided it would be better once the original one was merged.
I added the issue #1732 and the PR #1731 for a couple of golfing changes in the proof.
